recognize_zh: 周邊血中滿是中到大型淋巴球，核圓或略不規則、少數有凹痕，染色質中度濃縮，部分可見單一明顯核仁，細胞質中等量淡藍，這是 prolymphocyte 樣形態；需流式與 CCND1 檢測才知是被套細胞淋巴瘤。
features: Marked lymphocytosis of medium to large lymphoid cells
Round to slightly irregular nuclei, some notched or cleaved, occasional bilobed form
Moderately condensed chromatin with a single visible nucleolus in some cells
Moderate amount of pale blue agranular cytoplasm
Relatively monomorphic population; no smudge cells in this field
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a marked increase in medium to large atypical lymphoid cells. The cells have round to slightly irregular nuclei, some with notches or clefts, moderately condensed chromatin, a single visible nucleolus in a subset, and moderate pale blue cytoplasm, imparting a prolymphocytoid appearance. Smudge cells are not evident. The morphology is suggestive of a B-cell lymphoproliferative disorder with prolymphocytoid cells; with CD5-negative, kappa-restricted B cells and IGH::CCND1 fusion, findings are consistent with leukemic mantle cell lymphoma with prolymphocyte morphology.

ddx.vs: B-PLL cells look similar but lack cyclin D1/IGH::CCND1, so FISH or cyclin D1 immunostain is required to separate them.
CLL shows predominantly small lymphocytes with block-like chromatin, smudge cells, and a CD5+/CD23+ phenotype.
SMZL cells are smaller with polar villous cytoplasmic projections and lack CCND1 rearrangement.

ddx.dx: Hairy cell leukemia variant/splenic B-cell lymphoma with prominent nucleoli
ddx.vs: These cells have abundant cytoplasm with circumferential hairy projections and are CD11c+/CD103 variable, cyclin D1 negative by FISH.
